Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the Philips Sopho S 1000 PABX. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Hassan Moussa Hassan at Esna Power Generation Station; the test was carried out on 29 October 2008 by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed
Safety Precautions
A work order must be opened | 
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment | 
Tools and Equipment
Avometer | 
Blower | 
Work to be Carried Out
Disconnect the power from the cabinet | 1.
Remove the cards from the cabinet | 2.
Clean the cabinet cards using the blower | 3.
Visual inspection of the cards' condition and replacement of any faulty ones | 4.
Insert the cards into their slots | 5.
Switch the power on | 6.
Check and measure the power-supply voltage values per the table | 7.
Test table for the power supplies of the Philips PABX
V | Measured value | Set value | Replaced | Not replaced
